configurePresets.name: windows-msvc-vs
configurePresets.displayName: Windows x64 - MSVC - Visual Studio generator (works from any prompt)
configurePresets.description: Start here. The Visual Studio generator locates the MSVC toolchain by itself, so this needs no developer command prompt and cannot be hijacked by another compiler on PATH. Multi-config: pass --config Debug or Release when building.

configurePresets.name: windows-msvc-debug
configurePresets.description: Faster builds, but cl.exe must already be on PATH: run this from an 'x64 Native Tools Command Prompt for VS 2022'. From a plain prompt it fails with 'CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER: cl is not a full path' - use windows-msvc-vs instead.

cacheVariables.//: Pinned deliberately. Without this, CMake picks whatever C++ compiler comes first on PATH - an installed LLVM silently wins over cl.exe, and you end up building against MSVC-compiled Qt with a GNU-like driver while CI builds with MSVC. PLAN.md section 1 froze MSVC x64.
cacheVariables.//linker: The linker needs pinning for the same reason and is easier to miss, because it fails later and looks unrelated: cl.exe compiles the test file, then the link step runs GNU ld with MSVC flags and reports 'cannot find /nologo'. CMAKE_LINKER is a separate cache entry from the compiler, so it also survives the compiler being re-detected in a build directory that was configured once with a GNU toolchain on PATH.
